question: Which instrument is played by the famous music personality Pt. Shiv Kumar Sharma?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma is an Indian music composer and Santoor player from the state of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• He also composed music for many Hindi films in collaboration with Hariprasad Chaurasia (Famous Falutist).
 
• He was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in the year 1985.
 
• He received the 'Padma Shri Award' in 1991. He also received the Padma Vibhusan in 2001.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
